hotel_name: Hotel Good Luck By Jmd Group

positive_snippets:
I recently stayed at Hotel Good Luck near IGI Airport, Delhi, and had a very comfortable experience. The best part of this hotel is its excellent location, just a few minutes away from the airport — perfect for travellers with early morning or late-night flights.

The check-in was smooth and quick, and the staff were polite, friendly, and always ready to help with luggage and travel needs. The rooms were spacious, air-conditioned, and well-equipped with TV, Wi-Fi, hot water, and all basic amenities. The beds were comfortable, and I had a peaceful night’s sleep.

The hotel offers great value for money, especially for short stays or transit guests. It’s ideal for families or solo travellers who want a safe, convenient, and budget-friendly place near the airport. The food service was good, and the staff made sure everything was served on time.

Overall, Hotel Good Luck lives up to its name – it’s a good choice for travellers who want comfort, convenience, and warm hospitality without spending too much. I’ll definitely recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a pleasant and reliable stay near Delhi Airport.

⭐ Rating: 4.5 / 5
✅ Location – Excellent
✅ Staff – Friendly & Helpful
✅ Cleanliness – Good
✅ Value for Money – Great

I had such a fantastic experience in this hotel. The services provided by the staff named Mr. Laxman, Mr. Prem and the GM named Mrs. Prema was outstanding and beyond the benchmark. I look forward to book at this place again. Thank you very much for the services again.

Very affordable hotel with pretty nice arrangement in the room. Specially the behaviour of the staff starting from the reception to catering to housekeeping, everyone tried their level best to make my stay comfortable. Thank you for such hospitality. Hope to visit again in future.
negative_snippets: Good hotel with very helpful and friendly staff. The room was quite cold with no heating, but they kindly provided extra blankets. Bedsheets seemed a bit old and not very well maintained, but overall the staff made the stay comfortable with their support.
After 22 hrs continue journey  Planned to take a break at this place for further trip. But couldn't get a sleep at all. Too noisy. Even we were on 4th floor.
